question: De los posibles venteos detectados por satélite desde 2024 dentro de alguna concesión, ¿cuántos están dentro de un área protegida del IGN?

attempts.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT gml_id, lon, lat FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado
  WHERE fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND lon IS NOT NULL AND lat IS NOT NULL
),
ce AS (
  SELECT c.id_concesion AS pid,
         (r->(i-1)->>0)::float AS x1, (r->(i-1)->>1)::float AS y1,
         (r->(i % jsonb_array_length(r))->>0)::float AS x2, (r->(i % jsonb_array_length(r))->>1)::float AS y2
  FROM sig_energia.concesion c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query(c.anillo::jsonb, 'strict $.** ? (@.type() == "array" && @[0].type() == "array" && @[0][0].type() == "number")') r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, jsonb_array_length(r)) i
  WHERE c.anillo IS NOT NULL AND c.anillo <> ''
),
cb AS (SELECT pid, min(x1) mnx, max(x1) mxx, min(y1) mny, max(y1) mxy FROM ce GROUP BY pid),
vc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gml_id, lon, lat FROM (
    SELECT v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat, cb.pid
    FROM v JOIN cb ON v.lon BETWEEN cb.mnx AND cb.mxx AND v.lat BETWEEN cb.mny AND cb.mxy
    JOIN ce ON ce.pid = cb.pid
    WHERE (ce.y1 > v.lat) <> (ce.y2 > v.lat)
      AND v.lon < (ce.x2 - ce.x1) * (v.lat - ce.y1) / (ce.y2 - ce.y1) + ce.x1
    GROUP BY v.gml_id, v.lon, v.lat, cb.pid
    HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
  ) s
),
ae AS (
  SELECT a.gid AS pid,
         (r->(i-1)->>0)::float AS x1, (r->(i-1)->>1)::float AS y1,
         (r->(i % jsonb_array_length(r))->>0)::float AS x2, (r->(i % jsonb_array_length(r))->>1)::float AS y2
  FROM ign.area_protegida a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_path_query(a.anillos::jsonb, 'strict $.** ? (@.type() == "array" && @[0].type() == "array" && @[0][0].type() == "number")') r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, jsonb_array_length(r)) i
  WHERE a.anillos IS NOT NULL AND a.anillos <> ''
),
ab AS (SELECT pid, min(x1) mnx, max(x1) mxx, min(y1) mny, max(y1) mxy FROM ae GROUP BY pid),
va AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT gml_id FROM (
    SELECT vc.gml_id, ab.pid
    FROM vc JOIN ab ON vc.lon BETWEEN ab.mnx AND ab.mxx AND vc.lat BETWEEN ab.mny AND ab.mxy
    JOIN ae ON ae.pid = ab.pid
    WHERE (ae.y1 > vc.lat) <> (ae.y2 > vc.lat)
      AND vc.lon < (ae.x2 - ae.x1) * (vc.lat - ae.y1) / (ae.y2 - ae.y1) + ae.x1
    GROUP BY vc.gml_id, ab.pid
    HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
  ) s
)
SELECT count(*) FROM va
